# Locality Guide: Muhlenberg County, Kentucky — Death Records, 1860–1910

## Jurisdiction
Muhlenberg County was formed in 1798 from Christian and Logan counties. It has had no boundary changes affecting the 1860–1910 research window. The standardPlace is **Muhlenberg, Kentucky, United States**.

## Critical Caveat: Death Certificate Era
Kentucky **statewide death certificates began 1 January 1911**. Because Elijah Wilkins was born c. 1814 and last appeared in the 1870 census (age ~56), he almost certainly died before 1911 — meaning he has **no state death certificate**. The research question's premise ("using Kentucky death certificates") cannot be met by the statewide series; the county death registers and substitute sources below must carry the search.

## Record-by-Record Survey

### 1. Kentucky, Deaths and Burials, 1843–1970 — County Death Registers
- **Collection:** 1804888 | 421,870 indexed records | FamilySearch (free)
- **Coverage for Muhlenberg:** FamilySearch vol. 007991103, 240 images, 1852–1910. **Only 4% name-indexed**; the remainder must be browsed image-by-image.
- **Also on Ancestry:** Kentucky, U.S., Death Records, 1852–1965 (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/1222/) — a separate index; search both.
- **Gap warning:** Coverage is partial for the 1860s–1870s in many Kentucky counties. A nil result here is not conclusive.
- **Access:** FamilySearch (indexed + browse images); Ancestry (separate index).

### 2. Kentucky Deaths, 1911–1967 — Statewide Death Certificates
- **Collection:** 1417491 | ~2.9 million records | FamilySearch (free)
- **Coverage starts 1 January 1911.** Useful only if Wilkins survived past 1910 (born c. 1814, that would make him 97+ — unlikely but not impossible).
- **Access:** Fully indexed + images on FamilySearch.

### 3. Kentucky Probate Records, 1727–1990
- **Collection:** 1875188 | 1,349,204 images | FamilySearch (free, browse-only)
- **Muhlenberg-specific volume:** 007834412, 612 images, covering 1858–1889 (administrator bonds, settlements). **0% indexed, not full-text searchable — browse-only.**
- **Value:** An estate file opened shortly after Wilkins's death would anchor the death year and may name heirs, executors, and the county of death.
- **Physical originals:** Kentucky Department for Libraries and Archives (KDLA): https://kdla.ky.gov/researchers/Pages/default.aspx

### 4. Muhlenberg County Court Order Books
- **FamilySearch vol.** 007834430, 488 images, 1799–1901. **0% indexed, not full-text searchable — browse-only.**
- May record estate-related orders (appointment of administrators, settlement orders) that narrow the death date.

### 5. Cemetery Records — Find a Grave
- **External link:** https://www.findagrave.com/cemetery/browse?location=Muhlenberg+County
- Tombstone inscriptions may supply exact death dates and burial location for persons whose deaths were never entered in a civil register.

## Access Summary
| Record Type | Repository | Access Level |
|---|---|---|
| County death registers (1852–1910) | FamilySearch (col. 1804888) | Indexed (4%) + browse images |
| County death registers (1852–1910) | Ancestry (col. 1222) | Separate index |
| Statewide death certs (1911–1967) | FamilySearch (col. 1417491) | Fully indexed + images |
| Probate records (1858–1889) | FamilySearch (vol. 007834412) | Browse-only |
| Court order books (1799–1901) | FamilySearch (vol. 007834430) | Browse-only |
| Cemetery records | Find a Grave | Online, searchable |
| Probate originals | KDLA | Physical repository |

## Gaps and Warnings
- No statewide death certificates exist before 1 January 1911.
- Muhlenberg County's pre-1911 death register is heavily unindexed and has known coverage gaps for the 1860s–1870s.
- Wiki research pages for Kentucky (FamilySearch) could not be retrieved during this survey (permission denied); consult https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Kentucky directly for additional guidance.

# Locality Guide: Muhlenberg County, Kentucky — Death Records, 1860–1910

## Jurisdiction
Muhlenberg County was formed in 1798 from Christian and Logan counties. It has had no boundary changes affecting the 1860–1910 research window. The standardPlace is **Muhlenberg, Kentucky, United States**.

## Critical Caveat: Death Certificate Era
Kentucky **statewide death certificates began 1 January 1911**. Because Elijah Wilkins was born c. 1814 and last appeared in the 1870 census (age ~56), he almost certainly died before 1911 — meaning he has **no state death certificate**. The research question's premise ("using Kentucky death certificates") cannot be met by the statewide series; the county death registers and substitute sources below must carry the search.

## Record-by-Record Survey

### 2. Kentucky Deaths, 1911–1967 — Statewide Death Certificates
